er_dual_plaque_desc: 1×1。玩家拥有并放入橱窗时，每个可用营业日有50%机会引荐一位上层普通买家；最短到访间隔2天，最多1位待来访。需有可售精品。取下停止新引荐，已预约客人照常来；仓库无效，同类不叠加。

1×1. When owned and displayed in the showcase, each available business day has a 50% chance of one ordinary Upper Level referral. At least 2 days between arrivals; at most one pending. Requires suitable stock. Removing it stops new referrals, not promised visits. Inactive in storage; duplicates do not stack.
er_dual_plaque_flavor: 底座背面刻着一行小字：莉迪亚，替朋友说话。
A small line is engraved on the back: Lydia, speaking up for a friend.
er_dual_biz_second_intro: 莉迪亚说你能找到便携净水器。预算 {0} 信用点，耐久至少要有 {1}。东西先给我看，价钱照常谈。
Lydia said you can find a portable water purifier. Budget {0} credits, at least {1} durability. Show me the item first; we'll negotiate the price normally.
er_dual_plaque_full: 先腾些位置。未能交付的饰品或纪念物仍可在后续来访补领。
Make some room. Undelivered ornaments or keepsakes remain available during a later visit.
er_dual_entry_resume: This conversation is not finished yet.
er_dual_notice_ending: 三个人的关系已经稳定下来。之后可以在日常来访中继续见到她们。
The three of you have settled into something steady. You can keep seeing them in everyday visits.
er_dual_gate_passed: 上层区声望检查点{0}已达成。后续来访已可安排，阶段资格已保留。
Upper Level reputation checkpoint {0} reached. The next visit can be arranged; this milestone is secured.
er_dual_gate_progress: 上层区声望：{0}／{1}。下一阶段奖励：{2}。达标后继续主线，日常与营业不受影响。
Upper Level reputation: {0}/{1}. Next reward: {2}. The main story resumes when reached; everyday visits and business continue.
er_dual_reward_received: Received {0}. Display it in the showcase to activate it.
er_dual_claim_line: 这个替你收着呢——{0}。这次腾出地方了吧？
I have been keeping this for you: {0}. Have you made room this time?
er_dual_perfume_claim: 那瓶香水还替你留着。这次拿好。
I still have that perfume for you. Take it this time.
er_dual_referral_intro: 莉迪亚提起过这家店。我想看看适合带回上层的东西，价钱照常谈。
Lydia mentioned this shop. I would like to see something suitable for the Upper Levels. We can negotiate as usual.
er_dual_referral_close: 今天就到这里。东西合适，我还会再来。
That will do for today. If the goods suit me, I will return.
er_dual_patron_desc: 1×1。玩家拥有并放入橱窗时，上层普通买家最终购买预算+30%，向下取整。到店时确定，中途取下或重摆不重算。仓库无效，同类不叠加；具名剧情、固定订单和其他MOD客户除外。

1×1. When owned and displayed, ordinary Upper Level buyers receive 30% more final spending budget, rounded down. Snapshot at arrival; removing or replacing it during a visit does not recalculate. Inactive in storage; duplicates do not stack. Excludes named story clients, fixed orders and other mods.
er_dual_patron_flavor: 她说这只是个摆件，却替你把底座擦得很亮。
She calls it a trinket, yet polishes its base for you.
er_dual_gratitude_desc: 1×1。玩家拥有并放入橱窗时，上层普通买家实际购买商品后额外给10%小费，每次来访最多150信用点。到店时确定，不扣买家预算、不复利；仓库无效，同类不叠加。具名剧情、固定订单和其他MOD客户除外。

1×1. When owned and displayed, ordinary Upper Level buyers leave an extra tip of 10% of actual goods payments, capped at 150 credits per visit. Snapshot at arrival. Does not consume buyer budget or compound. Inactive in storage; duplicates do not stack. Excludes named story clients, fixed orders and other mods.
er_dual_gratitude_flavor: 底座上的字很小：承蒙照应。
Tiny words on the base: With thanks for your care.
er_gala_not_attend_desc: 明确谢绝本次邀请，不再另约下一场；关系不变。
Decline this invitation without arranging another party. Your relationship is unchanged.
er_dual_resolution_ack: All right. Then that is what we have agreed.
